# @rnw-community/histogram-metric-decorator

> Framework-agnostic method decorator that records call duration into any histogram transport (Prometheus,
> OpenTelemetry, in-memory, ...). Handles sync, `Promise`, and `Observable` return types. Built on
> `@rnw-community/decorators-core`; requires TypeScript `experimentalDecorators`. `rxjs` is an optional peer, needed only
> for `Observable`-returning methods.

The `labels` callback receives the method args as a tuple inferred from the method signature. The default metric name
is `${className}_${methodName}_duration_ms`; consumers ship their own transport.

## Landing

- [readme.md](readme.md): Observation timing table, usage, crash-safe label resolution, and full public API.

## Guides

- [When the observation fires](readme.md#when-the-observation-fires): Duration emission timing for sync, `Promise`, and `Observable` returns, including errors.
- [Usage](readme.md#usage): Wiring a transport, per-decoration `name` / `labels`, and the default metric name.
- [Crash-safe label resolution](readme.md#crash-safe-label-resolution--onlabelserror): Observations still emit when `labels` throws; observe throws via `onLabelsError`.

## API reference

- [`createHistogramMetricDecorator`](readme.md#createhistogrammetricdecorator): Factory taking `{ transport, onLabelsError? }` that returns the `@HistogramMetric(config?)` decorator.
- [`HistogramTransportInterface`](readme.md#histogramtransportinterface): `observe(name, durationMs, labels?)` contract for plugging in any metrics backend.
- [`HistogramOptionsInterface`](readme.md#histogramoptionsinterfacetargs): Per-decoration `{ name?, labels? }` passed to `@HistogramMetric(...)`.
- [`CreateHistogramMetricOptionsInterface`](readme.md#createhistogrammetricoptionsinterface): Options object accepted by `createHistogramMetricDecorator`.
